Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains three distinct proteomics workflows: a global proteome (DDA, LFQ), an ADP-ribosylome (DDA, LFQ, Af1521 enrichment), and a phosphoproteome (DIA, LFQ, ZrIMAC enrichment). Because of the mix of DDA and DIA, acquisition_type is set to Unknown. The ADP-ribosylation modification is a primary target but does not have a predefined modifier in the provided ontology list.

scope: GST-tagged Af1521 macrodomain beads, produced in-house BL21(DE3) bacteria and coupled to glutathione Sepharose 4B beads (Sigma-Aldrich), essentially as previously described, were added to peptides (100 μl dry beads per 10 mg sample) and incubated in a head-over-tail mixer at 4 °C for 3 h to enrich for ADPr peptides.

Enrichment of phosphopeptides was performed in a 96-well plate format on a KingFisher Flex robot (Thermo Fisher Scientific) essentially as described in Bekker-Jensen et al., using 5 μl of ZrIMAC-HP beads (MagResyn, Resyn BioSciences) per sample.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed three types of proteomics: global proteome (whole cell lysate), ADP-ribosylome (affinity-purified using Af1521 macrodomain beads), and phosphoproteome (affinity-purified using ZrIMAC-HP beads). Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material overrides the whole cell lysate for the sample_scope.
